units.time: ticks (60 per second); volley_frames count from the tick the fire input is taken
units.angles: BAMS: 65536 = 360 degrees; homing in radians per tick

model.spawn: muzzle locator world position (R+0x8F0 = gun model 0 locator 0)
model.direction: muzzle locator world X axis, normalised (target-pointing for gun 24)
model.per_tick: if timer==0 and phase==aim_phase: fan + random spread; homing (yaw then pitch, clamped); pos += dir * speed
model.phase_end: after `duration` ticks go to the next non-zero phase; past phase 4 the round expires
model.projectile_matrix: local +Y = flight direction, X = dir x up, Z = X x dir, uniform scale = radius
model.projectile_anim_rate: 30 / phase duration anim frames per tick (anim restarted at fire)

effects.archive0_modelset1: muzzle flash, drawn at the muzzle locator for 10 ticks after each volley
effects.archive0_modelset2: instanced at the gun root (G+0x2DC) but never shown (G+0x296 never set)
effects.archive1_modelset0: robo-hit effect, spawned on the target surface

trail_model.section: 6 vertices: cur(-X, 0, +X) from the projectile matrix now, prev(-X, 0, +X) from the matrix 2 ticks ago (first section: prev = current rotation at the muzzle locator position)
trail_model.edge_offset: matrix X column (= normalize(dir x up) * phase radius) * half_width * taper
trail_model.taper: e = tail + count before the push; cur = clamp(sqrt((e+1)/6), 0.05, 1), prev = clamp(sqrt(e/6), 0.05, 1)
trail_model.strip: GX_TRIANGLESTRIP over vertices 4,5,3,5,2,0,1 (cur+X, cur0, prev+X, cur0, prev0, cur-X, prev-X)
trail_model.alpha: a_c * (1 - k/length), floored at 0; k = samples since that end was taken (newest end 1)
trail_model.gx: XLU pass, unlit vertex colour and vertex alpha, no texture, blend SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA, z compare LEQUAL, no z write, no alpha test, cull none
trail_model.lifetime: kept while the round is flying (state 1) or stopped (state 2, keeps sampling the frozen matrix so the tail retracts one section per 2 ticks); reset and hidden as soon as the slot is freed

guns.name: Splash Gun
guns.special: each new volley hides the models of this gun's projectiles still in flight (0x80042D6C)

guns.name: Drill Gun
guns.special: projectile animation restarted only on the first volley; flight sound only on even volleys

guns.name: Titan Gun
guns.special: aims each round straight at the target's R+0x10D4 point instead of the muzzle X axis (G+0x26F01); robo hits need a clear line of sight (G+0x26F00)

guns.name: Knuckle Gun
guns.special: robo hits need a clear line of sight from the target to the round (G+0x26F00, 0x80041810)

guns.name: Meteor Storm Gun
guns.special: flight sound only on even volleys

guns.name: Twin Fang Gun
guns.special: projectile animation restarted only on the first volley (G+0x26F02 is set but its only read is dead)
